emails.subject: Field service leaders ditching paper in Orlando
emails.body:
Jen,

Quick stat from our Field Service East registration data: 61% of our 133 confirmed buyers are VP/Director level, and a significant chunk come from companies running large field operations â€” Altec Industries, MC Dean, Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions.

These are exactly the teams still wrestling with manual data capture, inconsistent field reporting, and technicians who hate paperwork.

Mobile forms adoption is a top-3 conversation at this event. Curious if GoCanvas has explored getting in front of this audience in Orlando (Aug 10-12).

Worth a quick conversation?

Ryan Casale
Field Service East

emails.subject: Squint will be there
emails.body:
Jen,

Following up â€” wanted to share more specifics on who's attending Field Service East.

We've got Regional Service Managers, Directors of Field Services, and VPs of Operations from companies like Harmar, Peak Scientific, Henny Penny, and BlueCrest. These are decision-makers actively evaluating how to modernize field workflows.

Squint is already sponsoring â€” they clearly see the value in this audience. The mobile forms/field data category is getting attention, and GoCanvas has an opportunity to own that conversation alongside them (or stand out from them).

Our sponsor packages put you in structured meetings with pre-qualified buyers, not just booth traffic. Happy to walk you through what's still available.

15 minutes this week?

Ryan Casale
Field Service East
